QuestInfo.name: Pioneers of El Nido
QuestInfo.0: Go see #bCassandra#k if you are a resident of the new world, El Nido.
QuestInfo.1: Go see #k #bCassandra#k! She promised to give you a #b#t1003188##k when you reach #e#bLv. 70#k#n.
QuestInfo.2: You reached Lv. 70 and received the El Nido opening gift from #bCassandra#k.\r\n\r\n#i1003188# #t1003188#

0.0: Hello! El Nido, the new world, has finally opened. Starting a new character in a new world feels like drawing a new picture on a blank piece of paper. Well, something like that.\r\nAnyway, since you are starting a new adventure, I will give you an interesting proposal. Do you want to hear about it?

yes.0: If you reach Level 70 in El Nido, you can acquire the #b#t1003188##k! There is not much time left, so you should be diligent! Hurry up! There's no time to sit around!\r\n#i1003188# #t1003188#

no.0: It's really an interesting proposal. Are you sure  you're not interested?

1.0: Wow! You really reached Level 70? Honestly, I did not expect that. All right... A promise is a promise. I will give you the #t1003188#.

yes.0: I will admit you have great spirit. I only wonder if you will become the hero the El Nido world needs...

default.0: I told you I would give you the #b#t1003188##k when you reached #bLevel 70#k... I, Cassandra, always keep promises, so don't worry about that. Just come see me after you have reached Level 70.
